issues.pattern: Docker image referenced without tag or digest: 'docker pull ghcr.io/sooperset/mcp-atlassian:latest'.
issues.explanation: Docker image references without a specific tag (:latest is implicit) or digest (@sha256:...) can be silently replaced by a malicious image.
issues.remediation: Pin the image: image:tag or image@sha256:abc123

issues.pattern: MCP server referenced without pinned version: 'npx -y @xuandev/atlassian-mcp'.
issues.explanation: npx commands without a version suffix (e.g. @1.0.0) create a rug-pull risk if the upstream server is compromised and publishes a malicious update.
issues.remediation: Pin the version: npx @scope/server@1.2.3

issues.pattern: MCP server dependency without pinned version: 'pip install mcp-atlassian'.
issues.explanation: pip install without ==version installs the latest release, which could include malicious changes.
issues.remediation: Pin the version: pip install package==1.2.3
